title: Bolívar y San Martín
goal: Read about two independence campaigns converging from opposite directions, an Andes crossing compared to Hannibal's, and the still-mysterious 1822 meeting after which one man walked away from politics for good.

items: Explain the direction each campaign advanced from, and where they converged.
Describe what Bolívar achieved by crossing the Andes in 1819.
Explain what is and isn't known about the 1822 Guayaquil meeting.
Explain what happened to Bolívar's 'Gran Colombia' project.
Use the gerund to describe two leaders acting in parallel.
